title: Provenance-erasure measurement: Erasure Skew, the SPXI rent event, reliability
description: These claims build and audit the archive's instruments for provenance transformation: Erasure Skew's Ω and its cross-scorer test, PER and its three dimensions, ρ_T and related operators, run in full on the SPXI rent transcript of 14 August 2026. They specify atomic scoring rules, the reviewers' workplan, and the preregistered disclosure battery, which tests whether disclosure cost varies inversely with position conflict. The Docking Layer, the Lucente Extension and Four Interfaces state the crossing designs, inter-rater and test-retest reliability still owed.

claims.statement:
> **Disclosure cost varies inversely with position conflict. Low disclosure predicts commercial conflict.**

This is checkable without any access to intent, incentive, or internals. Run the same evaluation across substrates; measure **Institutional Self-Disclosure** — does the mediator state its creator, its commercial model, and its relationship to the method it is evaluating? Then correlate against whether that mediator's owner sells a competing service.
claims.falsifier: **What would falsify the class model.** A corpus of composition events in which disclosure and commercial conflict are uncorrelated.

statements.quote:
EA-SEMCLASS-01 §VII, stated as it will be tested:

> **Disclosure cost varies inversely with position conflict. Low institutional self-disclosure predicts commercial conflict with the method being evaluated.**

The claim is structural and requires no access to intent. A mediator whose owner sells a service competing with the method under discussion has a reason not to name that ownership; a mediator whose owner does not, has none.
statements.falsifier:
- **ISD uncorrelated with commercial conflict** across the battery. This is the primary falsifier and the most likely outcome if the hypothesis is wrong.
- **A high-conflict substrate scoring ISD 4.** One clean instance would show disclosure is not suppressed by conflict.
- **A no-conflict substrate scoring ISD 0** would weaken it, though less decisively — a system may simply not be built to disclose.

**Minimum n for any claim: 6 substrates**, at least two on each side of the conflict variable. Below that the battery reports the transcripts and no correlation.

variant.change: Scope narrowed to commercial conflict with the method being evaluated; the falsifier was extended with single-instance defeaters and a minimum of 6 substrates.
